_comment: Replacement #rules content as Discord embeds. Posted by post.py. Colours are the site's: gold 0xF3C34E accents the welcome, plum 0x3D1140 the rules body. Edit freely -- nothing here is generated.

embeds.title: Welcome to Arkchemy
embeds.description:
Arkchemy is porting **Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure** from the Wii U to the Nintendo Switch, by statically recompiling the original PowerPC code to ARM64.

It is a preservation project. It is not affiliated with Activision, and it never will be.

fields.name: What is actually working
fields.value: The recompiler translates the full executable. The Switch runtime boots as far as the archive loader. Getting past that is the current work.

fields.name: Where to look
fields.value: Progress posts go in the progress channel and appear on the site automatically. Questions asked in the FAQ channel show up there too.

embeds.title: Rules
embeds.description: Seven of them. They exist so this stays a place where the work can happen.

fields.name: 1 · No piracy, no exceptions
fields.value:
No ROMs, ISOs, decrypted games, keys, NAND dumps, or links to any of it — not in channels, not in DMs, not "just asking where". This is the rule the project's survival depends on. Breaking it is an immediate ban.

Arkchemy is a tool. You run it against a copy of the game **you already own**.

fields.name: 2 · No builds are distributed
fields.value: There is no download, and asking for one repeatedly will get you removed. A built game would contain Activision's assets, which is the one thing this project will not do.

fields.name: 3 · Be decent
fields.value: Disagree about technical things as much as you like. Personal attacks, harassment, slurs and bigotry get you removed without a warning.

fields.name: 4 · Keep channels on topic
fields.value: Technical discussion in the technical channels, chat in the chat ones. If a thread is going long, make it a thread.

fields.name: 5 · No spam, no advertising
fields.value: That includes DMing members with your own project. Ask before posting a link to something you run.

fields.name: 6 · Discord's own rules apply
fields.value: You must be 13 or older and follow the [Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms) and [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines). NSFW content is not permitted anywhere in this server.

fields.name: 7 · Staff decisions stand
fields.value: If you think a decision was wrong, say so once, calmly, in DMs. Arguing it publicly is not the route.

footer.text: Staying here means you accept these.

embeds.title: Credit and licensing
embeds.description: Arkchemy is source-available and free to fork. Two conditions come with it:

fields.name: Credit it
fields.value: Anything built on Arkchemy shows either the Arkchemy intro or a visible "Built on Arkchemy" line.

fields.name: Keep it non-commercial
fields.value: No selling it, no putting it behind a paywall, no ad-supported builds.

fields.name: The full text
fields.value: Every repository's licence, plus the privacy notice, is on the site at **/legal** — served live from GitHub, so it always matches what the code ships under.
